primary: exact shared CDLI P-number catalog_alias claim (candidate alias, not proven identity)
exact duplicate normalized signs token sequence (>=10 derived signs)
exact duplicate normalized ATF reading sequence (>=10 readings)

near_duplicate_sensitivity.unit: consecutive derived signs within one line
near_duplicate_sensitivity.status: uncertain; sensitivity only, never used to delete parallels

stage_a.selection: types eligible for a stratum sorted lexicographically, chosen with random.Random(seed+stratum key).sample; selection uses oracle frequencies only to place queries in strata
stage_a.graph_subset: first 2 queries of signs n=2 common/mid, signs n=3 common/mid, 2 frames (common, mid), 2 bounded-gap (common, mid)

stage_b.units: signs field derived signs only; windows never cross a line, gap or unsupported position
stage_b.null: order-1 sign transition chain fitted on train lines only; analytic expectation conditioned on observed context slots (E_ABC = N(A,B,sign) * p(C|B); E_A?C = N(A,sign,sign) * sum_B p(B|A) p(C|B))
stage_b.threshold_rule: smallest value such that eligible types per test family <= 100000 and discovery pass < 10 CPU-minutes in the train-only resource pilot
stage_b.effect: d = log2((O + 0.5) / (E + 0.5)); 0.5 added to both observed and expected
stage_b.control: per candidate one control of the same test family: discovery-eligible, |d_disc| <= 0.25, same floor(log2 O_disc) bin, chosen by smallest sha256(seed+candidate+type) without replacement

bootstrap.unit: primary family in the confirmation split

stage_b.primary_hypothesis: H_B1: mean d_conf(candidates) - mean d_conf(controls) > 0, decided by family-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0, per test family (trigram, frame)
stage_b.individual_motifs: exploratory: per-motif d_conf with uncorrected 95% family-bootstrap interval; no BH/significance claim

stage_c.target_rule: signs position with derived-sign target and derived-sign immediate left and right neighbours in the same line
stage_c.context: L2 L1 [MASK] R1 R2; context tokens are sign labels or GAP/UNS/BOS/EOS literals
stage_c.ties: score desc, train unigram count desc, label asc

stage_d.run_if: A-C complete and cumulative CPU < 60 minutes

methods.ovl: binary sign n-grams n=1..3, overlap coefficient
methods.ovl_len_tfidf: binary sign n-grams n=1..3, weight n^2 * log((1+|D|)/(1+df)), weighted overlap coefficient

stage_d.exclude: query artifact and its primary family (CDLI alias / exact duplicate)
stage_d.claims: none; blinded packet for future expert judgment
